Obsnapmeter- CROSS CUT ADHESION TEST KIT (MASTER PAINT PLATE) 
The Master Paint Plate Cross Cut Adhesion Test Kit is a compact, multi-functional stainless steel tool used to evaluate coating adhesion and application quality. It combines a cross cut adhesion tester, wet film thickness gauge, wet film applicator, and edge rounding checker in one durable plate.
Multi-Function Tool – Includes 1, 2, and 3 mm cross-cut grids, wet film applicator (0–180 µm), and thickness gauge (50–160 µm).
Edge & Leveling Check – Features R2, R3, R4, R5 edge rounding check and a leveling test to indicate coating viscosity.
Standards Compliant – Meets NEN-EN-ISO 2409 and ASTM D3359 requirements.
Durable & Portable – Made of robust stainless steel (100 × 55 mm); supplied with cutting tool and adhesion tape.

Description
The Obsnapmeter Cross Cut Adhesion Test Kit (Master Paint Plate) is a multifunctional stainless steel inspection tool designed for professional coating evaluation. In addition to performing cross cut adhesion tests with 1 mm, 2 mm, or 3 mm grid spacing in accordance with NEN-EN-ISO 2409 and ASTM D3359, the plate integrates several essential coating control features into one compact device (100 × 55 mm). Its robust stainless steel construction ensures durability, corrosion resistance, and easy transport for both laboratory and on-site inspections.
Beyond adhesion testing, the Master Paint Plate includes a wet film thickness gauge ranging from 50 to 160 µm, a wet film applicator adjustable from 0 to 180 µm, and a leveling test edge that provides a quick indication of coating viscosity. The corner sections incorporate edge-rounding checks (R2, R3, R4, R5) to verify proper substrate preparation. Supplied complete with a cutting tool and adhesive tape (ISO 2409 versions available separately), this all-in-one solution enhances efficiency and reproducibility in coating quality control and application assessment.
Tapes for the cross cut adhesion test
Tape For Adhesion Test according ISO 2409:2003
Tape For Adhesion Test according ISO 2409:1999 can be ordered separately as well.
